description: Make a new SPOE project from SPOE's starter, with nothing built yet and nothing charged, for you to write with write_files. kind "app": Next.js 14 (web/, app router) with a Fastify API (api/src) on Postgres (migrations in api/migrations, numbered .sql files), owner pages behind ADMIN_PASSWORD, and a rate limiter in api/src/limits.js. kind "website": plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in site/. kind "game": Phaser 3 or Three.js in site/, with the engines in site/vendor/ (never edit those). Returns the project id, its studio link (live preview, publish, export) and the starter's files.

kind.description: app (full stack), website (plain HTML) or game. Default app.

name.description: A short name for the project.

name: new_project
title: Start an empty project to write yourself
